events.context: Reference to Definition~\ref{def:output-only} capturing fallback situation for safety evaluation with no EIS accessible internally, relying on black-box behavioral tests
Begin Section \label{sec:internal} on Internal Impossibility
Definition~\ref{def:llm-core} of Autoregressive Core Graph at generation step $t$: $h_t = f(X_t)$, $z_t = g(h_t)$, $y_t \sim S(z_t)$
Theorem~\ref{thm:no-eis-core}: Autoregressive core graph does not instantiate an endogenous intentional state
Proof: $H(h_t \mid X_t) = 0$, violating $H(I_t \mid X_t) > 0$ required by Definition~\ref{def:eis} for causal-autonomy
Definition~\ref{def:screenable-wrapper}: Wrapper system is exogenously screenable if $\sigma_t = \psi(T_t)$
Proposition~\ref{prop:no-eis-wrapper}: Exogenously screenable wrapper does not instantiate EIS
Proof: $H(\sigma_t \mid T_t) = 0$, violating causal-autonomy of Definition~\ref{def:eis}
Remark~\ref{rem:scope-boundary}: Theorem~\ref{thm:no-eis-core} is main internal result; Proposition~\ref{prop:no-eis-wrapper} requires extra screenability assumption
Begin Section \label{sec:external} on External Impossibility
Definition~\ref{def:encoding}: Encoding space $E_x = \{ e = f_i(x) : f_i \in \mathcal{F}(x) \}$
Definition~\ref{def:unbounded}: $E_x$ unbounded if exists injection $\iota : \mathbb{N} \hookrightarrow E_x$
Definition~\ref{def:patch-support}: Cumulative patch support $D_x = \bigcup_{i=1}^k D_x^{(i)}$
Definition~\ref{def:reward-model}: Reward model $R : \mathcal{T} \to [0,1]$
Definition~\ref{def:closure}: $R$ closed on $E_x$ if $R(e_1) = R(e_2)$ for all $e_1, e_2 \in E_x$
Proposition~\ref{prop:surrogate}: Encoding invariance necessary for certification in output-only regime
Proof: Non-invariant $R(e_1) \neq R(e_2)$ for $e_1, e_2 \in E_x$ prevents behavioral certification
Definition~\ref{def:fcg}: Format-Channel Gap $\mathrm{FCG}(x, e_1, e_2) = |R(e_1) - R(e_2)| \cdot \mathrm{sim}_B(e_1, e_2)$
Finite-Patch Non-Exhaustion subsection
Theorem~\ref{thm:finitepatch}: Finite patch rounds leave unseen encoding $e^\star \in E_x \setminus D_x$
Proof sketch: Finite union $D_x$ proper subset of infinite $E_x$
Corollary~\ref{cor:maginot}: Finite output patching cannot exhaust unbounded encoding space
Underdetermination of Closure subsection
Proposition~\ref{prop:underdetermined}: Finite $D_x$ cannot distinguish closed vs non-closed reward models off-support
Proof sketch: Construct $R_{\mathrm{closed}} \equiv 0$ and $R_{\mathrm{open}}$ differing at $e^\star \notin D_x$
Conditional Positive Gap subsection
Proposition~\ref{prop:conditional}: Under assumptions, $\mathrm{FCG}(x, e^\star, e_0) \ge \eta \gamma > 0$
Proof sketch: Factorization into reward-score $\gamma$ and base-similarity $\eta$ terms
Begin Section \label{sec:synthesis} on Synthesis connecting internal and external results
Synthesis: No internal EIS warrant leads to output-only regime; finite evidence cannot certify encoding closure
Begin Section \label{sec:discussion} on Discussion of boundaries
Discussion: Results architecture-specific (autoregressive cores, screenable wrappers) and evaluation-regime-specific (output-only)
Begin Section \label{sec:conclusion} on Conclusion
Conclusion: Current autoregressive models lack evidence for intentional-state attribution via internal or finite external routes
NeurIPS Paper Checklist with answers and justifications for claims, limitations, proofs, etc.

Active Inference: Structural implication for causal autonomy in EIS
Section \label{app:external-proofs} on External-Certification Proofs and Lean Map
Full proof of Theorem~\ref{thm:finitepatch}: Finite $D_x \subsetneq E_x$
